A '''Black Sun stronghold''' was established by the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on the remote [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. It was a small base in a remote mountain region of the moon. Most of the base was built underground, with only a small building visible from above. Its purpose remains unknown. 1.5 years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent investigating the whereabouts of the rogue Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] found out that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait|Sait]] tried to sell the ship to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Upon learning this, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Appleton]] sent him to the stronghold to find information about the ship's location. The agent infiltrated the base and killed several well armed Black Sun members until he found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with the sought-after coordinates.

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Sun stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Black Sun stronghold was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> This base was part of the short series of quests that players were required to do before they were allowed to enter the Star Destroyer Heroic Encounter aboard the ''Blackguard''.
